_about: Scenarios for pass.py (display-hive.md § 3/§ 4). Times are epoch ms; S = 100000 is the scenario base. Fixture writes happen at 1000, a stroke at 2000 settles them. At S the fixture windows have decayed: clock/weather/timer decay 0.3417 (score 0.0854), chat decay 0.925 (score 0.2775 < bar 0.3, closed). Run: python3 run.py

scenarios.title: Tap on a relevant (open, not leading) canvas window: put away, systemwide
Typed turn: the chat app writes turn_id + touched; the pass sees an app touch and the last turn_id (channel stations are outside the pass)
dock_max 5, nine apps (two seats, one pin, one urgent, five others): five tiles, the four lowest others fall
Note tap while the chat leads: note focus at once below the bar, chat co-closed, until led_until
Two timers, same score, same since: the smaller id is front; put away the front one, the other takes over, neither counts for unseen
Answer to a turn: the chat app's answer touch (touched) and the judge's last turn/answer from the lines (spoken or not is the channel's, outside the pass)
Press on the OS mark: no event, no pass, nothing changes
The dot: unseen > 0 is systemwide; whether the dock is closed is the profile's dock_default or a press (client)
judged_hidden + tap: the tap clears the verdict and holds the window; a later verdict does not close it while led_until > now
Two modals above the bar: one focus on level 2, the other ambient tile only
inputs at the door: tv forced to [], a profile without inputs is [], phone too; what is bound follows
decay 0 but relevant_until in the future: present, tile, score 0, rung ambient
The answer wakes the standing weather window (turn_id on an own-prop touch): the chat closes in that pass and again on its own answer touch
TV dock_max 7 vs monitor 8: same open windows, fewer tiles, same order (put-away without a tile is a client binding, not a state)
What the judge sees: no rank, tile, level, dock_max, dismissed_at; no non-present view; without a verdict bar = focus_default, weights 0.5
Dock order: seats by seat_ord from the bottom, then rank ascending, the highest on top
The switch is client-only (§ 6.5, no state); the door accepts a screens map without phone when default_screen names an entry
Touch list and pass triggers: minute, measurement, state alone, verdict, put-away tap, stroke are no touch; own prop, touched, tap, hold are; the judge only after app touches
Clock not present: the weather stands at its own height with air below; the empty seat does not count; withdrawal takes the seat
Weather tap while the chat is open: the weather is put away and the chat co-closed (dismissed_at, led_until = 0 on both)
A-en3-F1, reading B: after a hold, a new turn changes the chat's turn_id; the old weather window no longer closes the chat; the new answer does
A-en3-F2: fresh ends with the next pass, whatever triggered it (a tap 300 ms later); the stroke only guarantees a pass within a second
A-en3-F3: a younger app touch ends the finger's lead; § 4.20 chooses by score among all — the held window with the highest score stays focus
Rival on the ladder (Delta E.20): tap on a window below the bar, then an app touch of a louder rival within the linger: the rival leads, the held one stays open as relevant until led_until
A-en3-F4: end_at lives in the child tile; the pass does not read it and its change is no touch
R-25-1: the tapped low-relevance window stays open through the clock's minute; it falls back at led_until, not at the next pass
R-25-2: a verdict with tiny relevance closes the window but takes no tile; presence ends by decay only
Put away, then re-urgent: the end of ringing (state removed alone) lifts nothing; the next ring with touched opens the window again
Chat closes via turn_id, order A: turn, fresh canvas window with the turn_id, then the chat's answer touch
Chat closes via turn_id, order B: turn, the chat's answer touch first, then the canvas window arrives
Chat closes via turn_id, order C: the canvas window arrives before the chat app has written the turn_id; the chat's late turn_id write closes it
topic_dupe: a fresh card of another app on the weather's topic is not present and carries no rung; the weather takes the touch; the dupe falls when the weather goes
topic_dupe carries the turn_id to the standing window for § 4.13: the chat closes when the dupe arrives
Standing but not present view: no rung, no tile, not shown to the judge; a touch makes it present again as settled
bar = 0: a score of 0 by decay is never open; a score > 0 is focus
Fresh takes no focus: the newly written loudest card is relevant in its pass and focus after the one-second stroke
Hold without a chat window: absorbed, nothing opens, no error
Linear decay: halfway through fade_ms the decay is 0.5; presence ends at the end of the fade
judge missing or off: no judge cell, a verdict is refused, bar = focus_default, every weight 0.5
An urgent with layer modal is on no ladder: front on level 3 while another modal is the one open modal on level 2
Hold on a chat with judged_hidden: the hold clears the verdict like a tap and opens the chat
A hold while the chat is already open never puts away; it renews led_until
Put-away urgent keeps rung urgent and rank 1, rings in its tile, is not front and not unseen
Ten taps in the same millisecond on one tile: each applies to the state after the previous one; an even count ends put away
The weight floor 0.05 belongs to the rank alone: a weight of 0.01 gives score 0.005 (closed) and rank 0.025
Tapped urgent vs a younger urgent: the tap makes timer-b front; a new ringing timer-c with a younger since takes the precedence and is front by the choice
Chat closes (§ 4.13) zeroes led_until: a hold-opened chat is closed by the answer's canvas window although its led_until lay in the future
Class default without a judge: an error note without relevance scores 0.8 × 0.5 = 0.4 and opens; an unknown class counts as unset (0.5)
The judge does not lift topic_dupe: a verdict naming the dupe with judged_hidden false changes nothing
A put-away tile keeps its rank by the formula and decays from there; the zero rules do not touch the rank
Dock cut reaches the seats last: dock_max 1 with clock, weather and a note leaves the clock and an empty weather seat that does not count
Judge interval: a second app touch within judge_min_interval_ms is discarded, not made up; the next one after the interval calls
A new verdict replaces the whole verdict: a window the new verdict does not name loses its old values; bar and weights are the new ones
After relevant_until the relevance is capped at 0.2 (score and rank)
linger is capped at linger_ms + fade_ms: a tap on a window asking 999999 holds it for 140000
Pinned: the tile stays, but score and rank decay like any window; the window closes when the score falls below the bar
ttl_ms withdraws the view: a stroke is ordered for the moment; that pass is the leaving pass; the next one removes the view from the store
Withdrawal of an open window: one leaving pass (still open, no focus), then gone from the store; a re-write afterwards is a new window
The door rejects: seat top, state loud, ttl_ms -1; a missing display_type and a missing default_screen are errors
Modal-closing rule on opening (Q4) and the reverse: a tap on a modal's tile co-closes nothing
Two held canvas windows: the younger tap leads, the older held one stays open as relevant
A held modal that does not lead is ambient, tile only: hold the chat, then tap a dialog's tile
A put-away clears no verdict; a tap that opens clears it
unseen is systemwide and independent of the dock cut: seven quiet fresh notes count 7 on every output although the phone draws five tiles
Strokes: after a write the curator orders the fresh second, the end of the linger, the end of the fade; the fixture windows add theirs
An app touch sets since = now, not the touched value (§ 4.8 literal; compose.py takes the moment)
touched not greater than the last seen is no touch; a repeated identical own prop is no touch
An app touch lifts a put-away (since > dismissed_at) for every window but the chat under § 4.13
Canvas order on every output: the leading one first, then score, then younger since, then id
Second urgent rings in its tile (Delta E.20): rung urgent, tile marked, level 0, counts for unseen
Typed turn end to end, the hive's part (Delta E.20): turn write, then the answer write; the chat opens on the turn and stays open on the answer while its score reaches the bar
state: urgent set alone on a standing window is no touch but the window is urgent and front (its since stays)
A tap on a window with a tile cut nowhere in the state: the tap on a non-present view is absorbed
The seat is known while the view stands in the store, also when cut: a cut clock leaves an empty bottom place on the narrow output
Cut stages: others fall before urgents, urgents before pinned, pinned before seats; a pinned urgent falls in the pinned stage
Weather measurement and a change of place: the measurement (children) is no touch, the topic (own prop) is
The clock's minute triggers a pass, sets no since, calls no judge; the decay runs on
Leaving takes no focus and is not unseen: a withdrawn quiet note is leaving one pass and out of unseen at once
Every value is systemwide: rung, level and open are one per window, whatever output asks; only the dock cut differs
Chat relevance by the app: 0.8 on a turn opens the chat (0.4 ≥ 0.3), 0.6 on an answer keeps it exactly to the end of its linger
Urgents take part in no focus choice: a ringing non-front timer with the highest score does not block the canvas focus
Hold on an output without audio, press on a tv, the switch: client-only gates, no event reaches the pass (documented, not modelled)
topic_dupe: same owner is never compared — a second timer of ambient on a used topic is a plain second window
Two modals, one held: a hold on the chat beats a louder dialog written in the same pass sequence (finger above the score)
Rank tie: equal rank, the younger since stands higher, then the smaller id
The chat put away by § 4.13 stays closed against its own answer touch, and opens again for an app touch once the canvas window lost presence
§ 4.13 with a touched-only write on the carrier (source c): the chat reopened by a tap closes again — the main clause and § 8.6 rule over the parenthetical list
§ 4.13 'the chat app writes that turn_id': a write of the same turn_id again (no touch) is a trigger while the carrier is present
topic_dupe compares against present windows only: a fresh card on the topic of a decayed (standing, not present) weather is no dupe
An unknown layer word is read as canvas (the door lists no rejection for layer)
A write merges per key: a later write without relevance keeps the relevance; an explicit empty value removes the key
ttl_ms counts from the last write of the view: a rewrite moves the expiry
Equal since among finger-led windows (two taps in the same millisecond): the smaller id leads; the same for two tapped urgents
A verdict without bar: the bar is focus_default while the weights and window values apply
ttl_ms runs out on a standing view that is not present: the view leaves the store at once, no leaving pass, and its seat goes with it
Hold with a second view on topic chat (a dupe of another owner): the hold reaches the present chat window, never the dupe

Tap on the tile of an urgent with layer canvas while the chat modal is open co-closes the modal: the tapped window's layer decides, not its rung — on put-away of the front urgent and on the tap that brings a second urgent to the front
fade_ms 0 and focus_default 1.5 at the door: refused once, the defaults 120000 and 0.3 stand, the pass runs and the decay falls over the default fade
dock_max "2" as text and dock_default "open" in the phone profile: 2 is read as the number, "open" is refused once and the type default hidden stands, the cut draws two tiles
seat: bottom without seat_ord stands at 0 and ties by id: between the clock (0, smaller id) and the weather (10)
relevance "1.5" is clamped to 1 at the door (score 0.5, not 0.75); relevance "-0.5" clamps to 0 and reads as empty (0.5, score 0.25, below the bar)
Two seats with the same seat_ord (10): the smaller id stands lower — the weather below the note
Pinned as is: a fresh note the judge hides (judged_hidden) still counts for unseen while its linger runs — the dot lights for a window that is deliberately not shown
scenarios.source: S3 R-12; § 4.33, § 4.14, § 4.22 (pinned as is, candidate for a Marcus question)

scenarios.title: Pinned as is: a topic_dupe that carries a seat leaves an empty seat place in the dock for a window that was never present
scenarios.source: S3 R-13; § 4.29, § 4.12, § 4.28 (pinned as is, candidate for a Marcus question)

scenarios.title: Pinned as is: a put-away weather is lifted by the topic touch (f) of another app's dupe — the member's put-away is undone by a foreign app on the same topic
scenarios.source: S3 R-16; § 5.2, § 4.8 f, § 4.12 (pinned as is, candidate for a Marcus question)

scenarios.title: Pinned as is: a fresh modal above the bar is ambient (tile only) in its first pass and opens with the next pass, at most a second later — a fresh canvas window is relevant at once
scenarios.source: S3 R-17; § 4.35, § 4.21, § 4.34 (pinned as is, candidate for a Marcus question)

scenarios.title: Pinned as is: relevance "0" reads as empty (§ 3.3), the window gets the default 0.5 — score 0.25, ambient; 0 is not a way to say "nothing"
hold carries no field: a topic a client sends with the hold is ignored, the hold reaches the window with topic chat
the end of ringing is state alone: a write that removes state and changes relevance in the same write is source (b) and lifts a put-away; the ambient app therefore writes state alone (§ 9.1)
A page is a window with a level: the screen joins its topic while the window stands on level 1 and leaves it at 0; a dock cut takes its tile on that output, never the window
A page in use does not decay: the cell's throttled report makes the application touch its own window (source c); the finger's input itself is no event and triggers no pass
The same topic twice from two applications: the fresh window is `topic_dupe` — no window, no tile, no page opened — and the standing one takes the touch and the fresh one's `turn_id`

A page card carries a minted topic of its own (`card:<card_id>`) even where its section named `weather:berlin`, so the standing ambient window on that subject is no rival: both are present, neither is `topic_dupe` — the model sees the topic, never the section and never the URL (Decision 18.09.)

#742: an app touch clears the standing verdict — source (b) wakes the hidden weather window in the same pass, source (c) clears it again even when the judge call falls into judge_min_interval_ms and is discarded
#742: the topic touch (f) leaves the standing verdict alone (the judge may have hidden the window on purpose), and an app touch of a window without a verdict changes no verdict

#742 Fix 2: clearing a verdict clears the whole standing judgement about that window — the woken weather window counts with the default weight 0.5, not with the `ambient` weight the judge wrote for the situation that just ended; the mark outlives the passes between, and the next judge run takes both back; a tap clears it the same way
